summary: Lists become command-line options: --ask-become-pass/-K, --become/-b, --become-method and --become-user, noting -K and --become-user don't imply become.
questions: What command line flag enables become?
How do I set the become user from the command line?

answer_card.title: become command-line options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `--ask-become-pass`, `-K`: prompt for the escalation password (used for all hosts); doesn't enable become
- `--become`, `-b`: run with become
- `--become-method=...`: `sudo` (default), `su`, `pbrun`, `pfexec`, `doas`, `dzdo`, `ksu`, `runas`, `machinectl`
- `--become-user=...`: default `root`; doesn't imply `-b`
